title: The Heart of the Base
subtitle: Forty-six rooms, arranged as one shape
description: Each node is one tile of a picture: nine tiles wide and seven tall on the
48-pixel grid, with the gaps left empty. The tiles are a base's rooms in
build order -- roughly -- and the picture they make is a heart, in
The chapter is linear, so nothing in any of these forty-six files declares
a dependency. The list order in this manifest is the progression, and it
is also the raster of the picture, snaking from the top-right lobe
across, down, and back, ending at the lowest point.
Forty-six quests is not a fair thing to ask of a reader who just wants to
see it. /tasked complete walks it one quest at a time, which is how this
one is meant to be looked at: from a distance, while it fills in.
